scope: Written audit of the rank-one-Schmidt input used for the 121 frame moment and harmonic criterion. No new family or independent review.
actual_factorization: For a pure rho=|psi><psi| set Qpsi=I-rho and u_(i,a)=Qpsi sigma_i^a|psi>. The compressed Pauli frame is M=Qpsi F(rho) Qpsi=sum_(i,a)|u_(i,a)><u_(i,a)|. At each site, choose a real unit Bloch direction n_i. If the Bloch vector is nonzero choose n_i along it; if it vanishes choose any direction. The projector onto the local + eigenvector of n_i dot sigma has Schmidt support in the actual state and (n_i dot sigma-r_i)psi lies in a fixed one-dimensional complex span of the two transverse projected Pauli vectors. If the local marginal is pure, the centered longitudinal vector vanishes; if the local Bloch vector vanishes, the local Pauli commutator still enforces a nontrivial complex relation among the three u_(i,a). Consequently rank(M)<=8 after summing four sites, using the same actual psi. A direct alternative avoids any basis selection: the three local tangent vectors are orthogonal to psi, and across each one|three cut the Schmidt rank is at most two, so the local rank-one Pauli orbit's centered image has complex dimension at most two.
verification_boundary: The elementary rank<=8 observation is not used as an unproved premise to strengthen the current 121 theorem, and this note does not claim any new bound on K3(F), nonzero eigenvalues, global k3, or an all-state harmonic inequality. The existing 121 rank<=12 argument remains sufficient and does not require this refinement. A disjoint reviewer would need to reconstruct the complex-linear local-image step and zero-radius/pure-marginal cases before using it elsewhere.
process: The owner remains in the no-new-family period until actual 121 review return. The five source corrections and both cadence findings are unchanged; the 145 delivery-message/146 attribution history is accurately qualified by 147.
